「配料照妖镜」就是为你做的 0 广告、免登录、100% 离线配料表扫描仪：

【为什么大家换用配料照妖镜？】
1. 不靠残缺条形码，直接 0.3 秒离线识读配料表原文
基于 Apple 原生设备端 Vision 文字识别引擎，山姆、零食很忙、进口货、杂牌、烘焙短保、护肤品中英文 INCI、猫粮狗粮 100% 全扫得出！地下超市负二层没信号照样秒出结果，照片绝不上传云端。

打开直接对着配料表拍，也支持直接导入淘宝/拼多多/叮咚商品详情页截图一键扫雷。

3. 6 大专属个人忌口雷达，按你的身体精准亮红灯
- 科技与狠活雷达：紧盯新国标 GB 2760-2024 烘焙禁用脱氢乙酸钠、氢化植物油、亚硝酸钠、TBHQ、人工合成色素，同时绝不误杀维生素 C 等安全成分。
- 控糖减脂雷达：揪出配料前三位加糖、果葡糖浆、麦芽糊精、植脂末与高倍人工代糖。
- 痛风 / 高尿酸雷达：专门拦截零添加酱油与泡面里最阴险的“隐形高嘌呤炸弹”——酵母抽提物、呈味核苷酸二钠 (E635)、海鲜浓缩粉与高果糖。
- 孕期与宝妈雷达：规避人工色素、防腐剂、咖啡因、酒精与孕慎护肤 A 醇。
- 敏感肌 / 致痘护肤雷达：识读中英文 INCI，揪出 5 级致痘酯 IPM/IPP、MIT 强致敏防腐、甲醛释放体与高浓度酒精。
- 猫狗粮避毒雷达：拦住木糖醇/洋葱/丙二醇/BHA/诱食剂，并自动识破不良商家“谷物分割法”陷阱！

en-US.name: PureScan: Ingredient Scanner
en-US.subtitle: Offline Food & Skincare Label
en-US.promotionalText: No more 'barcode not found', forced logins, or pop-up ads! Scan ANY ingredient label 100% offline in 0.3s across Food, Skincare INCI, Gout/Purine & Pet Food.
en-US.description:
Tired of ingredient scanner apps that fail with 'Barcode Not Found' on local snacks, store brands, imported items, or pet food—or lock you out behind aggressive paywalls and logins?

PureScan reads the actual ingredient label directly using 100% on-device Apple Vision OCR. Zero ads, zero accounts, zero cloud uploads—works instantaneously even in supermarket aisles with zero signal!

KEY FEATURES
• Instant Offline Label OCR (Not Limited by Barcodes): Scan food packages, local store brands, imported snacks, skincare INCI bottles, cat/dog kibble, or online shopping screenshots in 0.3 seconds.
• 6 Personalized Health & Safety Radars: Instead of rigid one-size-fits-all scores that penalize healthy whole foods, tailor PureScan to YOU — Clean Additives, Low Sugar/Keto, Gout/High Purine (catches sneaky Yeast Extract & E635), Mom & Kids, Acne/Sensitive Skincare INCI, and Pet Food Safety (with automatic Grain-Splitting Trap detection!).
• Custom Allergen Blacklist: Add your own red-flag triggers (Peanut, Gluten, Soy, Dairy) for instant red alerts.
• Supermarket VS Showdown: Torn between two yogurts, breads, or cat foods? Compare them side-by-side to see the cleaner winner in 1 second.
• Red & Green Cabinet + Shareable Inspection Receipts: Save Buy-Again favorites, blacklist junk forever, and export crisp lab-receipt cards.

FAIR & TRANSPARENT PRO ACCESS
• Free forever: 10 offline scans/day, zero ads, no login required.
• PureScan Pro: Monthly ($1.99/mo), Annual ($9.99/yr with 3-day free trial + built-in Day-2 local reminder so you're never surprise-billed), or Lifetime Pay-Once ($14.99).

Educational reference only based on public FDA/EFSA/GB 2760/INCI/AAFCO standards; not medical advice.
